approval.approval_reference: Internal editorial checkpoint under current main docs/special-human-gates.md: the user requested autonomous work through the first Human Gate, so Candidate Selection is completed internally and Architecture remains PROPOSED for explicit Architecture Review.

FEATURE_CORE.title: OpenAI Codex February stack: app, GPT-5.3-Codex, System Card, and Codex-Spark
FEATURE_CORE.selection_rationale: The strongest single February package connecting coding models, persistent multi-agent workspace, long-running tool use, cyber-risk evaluation, and low-latency interaction.
remaining_boundaries: The Evidence task intentionally groups four related first-party items; drafting must keep product, base model, system-card, and specialized Spark boundaries explicit.
Performance and benchmark comparisons are vendor-reported.
Codex-Spark’s throughput statement depends on specialized Cerebras hardware and research-preview conditions.
Cyber capability classification must reproduce the System Card’s stated threshold/precaution boundary rather than exaggerating it.

SECTION_CORE.title: Claude Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 independently reinforce February's move toward sustained coding, computer use, planning, and long-context agentic work.
remaining_boundaries: This Evidence task groups two related February model releases rather than treating them as independent articles.
Capability and benchmark comparisons are vendor-reported and are not independently reproduced here.
Availability and 1M-context status must preserve announcement-time beta/product boundaries.

SECTION_CORE.title: Gemini 3 Deep Think — February 2026 update
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: Gemini 3 Deep Think provides an independent specialized-reasoning axis focused on science, research, and engineering.
remaining_boundaries: Deep Think is a specialized reasoning mode, so its results should not be generalized to the entire Gemini 3 family.
Announcement-time API availability was limited/early access.
Scientific benchmark and comparison claims are vendor-reported.

SECTION_CORE.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro / Gemini 3.1 Flash Image February API releases
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Flash Image Preview cover late-February tool/reasoning and image-generation API evolution without conflating them with Deep Think.
remaining_boundaries: Both highlighted model identifiers were preview-stage February releases; drafting must not describe them as generally stable at that date.
The API changelog is chronology evidence and does not independently validate quality/benchmark claims.
This task combines a reasoning/tool-use model update and an image-generation model update; architecture should split their editorial roles if needed.

SECTION_CORE.title: GLM-5
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: GLM-5 is a major open-weight February release explicitly targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks, with concrete architecture and training-system disclosures.
remaining_boundaries: Architecture/training figures are first-party technical disclosures, not independently audited.
Benchmark superiority statements remain vendor-reported.
The model’s release and license can be verified independently from its claimed performance.

SECTION_CORE.title: MiniMax M2.5 + Forge agent-native RL
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: M2.5 plus Forge links an agentic coding/tool-use model directly to agent-native reinforcement-learning infrastructure.
remaining_boundaries: M2.5 benchmark and relative-speed figures are not independently reproduced.
Forge scale statements and training-throughput claims are first-party reports.
Architecture should distinguish the public model release from the training-system story rather than imply Forge itself is a broadly available product.

SECTION_CORE.title: Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-Coder-Next February Model Studio rollout
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-Coder-Next provide a major Chinese/open-model anchor spanning multimodal reasoning, coding, tool interaction, and repository-level work.
remaining_boundaries: Model Studio availability and dates differ by China/international region; drafting must preserve the regional scope of each lifecycle entry.
The lifecycle page is a living document and may include later global rollouts; February chronology must use the dated entries rather than current availability alone.

SECTION_CORE.title: vLLM v0.15.1 / v0.16.0
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: vLLM v0.16.0 is the clearest stable serving-runtime anchor, spanning realtime audio, Responses/tool APIs, speculative decoding, parallel scheduling, and heterogeneous hardware.
remaining_boundaries: The v0.16.0 branch-cut date means it cannot be used as evidence that every late-February model change was already integrated.
Performance figures are project release-note measurements and are not independently reproduced.
The series groups one patch and one major release; architecture should center v0.16.0.

SECTION_CORE.title: Voxtral Transcribe 2 / Voxtral Realtime
SECTION_CORE.selection_rationale: Voxtral Realtime gives the issue an independent realtime-speech axis and prevents a text-only coding-agent narrative.
remaining_boundaries: Sub-200ms latency and accuracy comparisons are vendor-reported and depend on the stated serving configuration.
Open-weight/license status does not imply every surrounding hosted service component is open source.
The task source is Mistral’s news index; item-level wording must remain consistent with the February launch article.

SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.title: SGLang v0.5.9
SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.selection_rationale: Strong evidence that the serving layer rapidly integrated Qwen3.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.5 and other February families; best used across model and systems sections rather than as a separate feature.
remaining_boundaries: Performance figures come from project release notes and are not independently reproduced.
Support entries establish implementation availability, not equivalent quality or benchmark validation across model families.

SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.title: Transformers v5.1 / v5.2 model-family integrations
SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.selection_rationale: Transformers v5.2.0 is unusually compact ecosystem evidence that GLM-5, Qwen3.5 and Voxtral Realtime reached a common implementation layer within the same month.
remaining_boundaries: Framework integration proves implementation/support landed in Transformers; it does not independently validate the model vendors’ benchmark claims.
v5.1.0 is supporting context; v5.2.0 is the materially stronger February integration milestone.
The v5.2 release also contains breaking interface changes, so model support should not be reduced to a simple compatibility list.

not_selected_for_architecture.title: DeepSeek API updates — February 2026 chronology check
not_selected_for_architecture.selection_rationale: Evidence Runner recommendation is REJECT; re-verify Evidence before promotion.
remaining_boundaries: Weekly why-now relevance is not confirmed.
Absence from the retained official update index is not evidence of universal absence.
A later or separately documented February item would require a new evidence source rather than backfilling it from memory.

not_selected_for_architecture.title: ComfyUI v0.15.x February workflow updates
not_selected_for_architecture.selection_rationale: Evidence remains HOLD/INSPECT_MORE; re-verify Evidence before promotion.
remaining_boundaries: The retained series contains only v0.15.0 and v0.15.1, while the repository had multiple February releases; it should not be presented as a complete monthly changelog.
The release is broad and incremental rather than a single month-defining architectural milestone.

not_selected_for_architecture.title: Kimi Code — February 2026 chronology check
not_selected_for_architecture.selection_rationale: Evidence remains HOLD/INSPECT_MORE; re-verify Evidence before promotion.
remaining_boundaries: Can a first-party, day-dated February 2026 Kimi coding-agent announcement be added without changing the frozen screening basis?
Weekly why-now relevance is not confirmed.
The supplied chronology is insufficient for a day-precise February event.
Do not infer a February Kimi Code release from later documentation or from broader Kimi product history without adding a primary source to the evidence set.

not_selected_for_architecture.title: TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0rc5
not_selected_for_architecture.selection_rationale: Evidence remains HOLD/INSPECT_MORE; re-verify Evidence before promotion.
remaining_boundaries: The retained task covers only rc5 rather than the full February RC sequence.
Prerelease status makes it unsuitable as a standalone month-defining release without stronger distinct technical significance.

rules: Issue Architecture may group several selected items into one comparison package.
Supporting evidence is not a duplicate story and need not receive its own article package.
Do not add HOLD_OUT or EXCLUDE items without a new Selection revision bound to an updated matrix.
No section quota is required; weak sections may be omitted.
Article drafting begins only after the Architecture Plan validates successfully.
